cd "C:/Users/hongy/.claude/projects/-Users-chenjiamin-arkTs-arkts-pilot-project-aippt-version-aippt-0723" && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json,glob,re
files=["9b3105a2-85ec-4889-9786-b3c220f06754.jsonl"]+sorted(glob.glob("9b3105a2-85ec-4889-9786-b3c220f06754/subagents/*.jsonl"))
pat=re.compile(r'adjustViewBounds')
seen=set()
for f in files:
    for i,line in enumerate(open(f,encoding='utf-8'),1):
        if 'adjustViewBounds' not in line: continue
        try: r=json.loads(line)
        except: continue
        msg=r.get('message') or {}
        c=msg.get('content')
        if not isinstance(c,list): continue
        for b in c:
            t=b.get('type')
            if t=='tool_result':
                cc=b.get('content'); s=cc if isinstance(cc,str) else "".join(x.get('text','') for x in cc if isinstance(x,dict))
            elif t=='text': s=b['text']
            elif t=='tool_use': s=json.dumps(b['input'],ensure_ascii=False)
            else: continue
            for m in pat.finditer(s):
                ctx=s[max(0,m.start()-260):m.start()+180].replace('\\n','\n')
                k=ctx[:120]
                if k in seen: continue
                seen.add(k)
                print(f.split('/')[-1], i, t, "|", ctx.replace('\n',' / ')[:440]); print()
EOF
